text:
jamie.cs: FYI — Customer 'Alder Apps' says their free-trial credits vanished after we merged two orgs this morning. They went from ~150 credits to 0 immediately after the merge. Can billing investigate?

alex.billing: Thanks Jamie. Can you paste the account id and the user email who reported it? Also, any repro steps or API responses?

sam.cs: Account ID: acct_0a1b2c3d. Reporter email: erin@alder.io. Repro steps provided by customer: merged org via console -> refresh -> credits show 0. They sent this API response from /v1/account: ``{\n  \"id\": \"acct_0a1b2c3d\",\n  \"credits\": 0,\n  \"last_activity\": \"2026-12-07T15:02:00Z\"\n}``

maria-billing: Looking at the logs — there was a background account-merge job at 2026-12-07T15:00:12Z that consolidated two org rows. The promo grant for acct_9f8e... (the older org) had an expiry of 2026-12-07T14:59:59Z. It appears the merge overwrote the newer account's credit balance with the expired row.

jamie.cs: Customer says they never used the credits and expected the remaining balance to carry over. They opened a support ticket and asked for manual reinstatement.

alex.billing: Policy note: promotional trial credits expire at the end of the trial window and are not automatically extended on merges. However, for platform-caused data-sync issues we can do a one-off remediation. I need confirmation of exact expiry time and whether there was any token usage after expiry. Can we pull token logs between 2026-12-07T14:50 and 2026-12-07T15:10?

ops-bot: Token billing logs for acct_0a1b2c3d: no token usage recorded between 2026-12-07T14:00 and 2026-12-07T16:00.

maria-billing: Confirmed. No usage after expiry. Looks like merge copied the expired promo row over the active one. This is a server-side migration bug.

tina.legal: From compliance POV, granting a one-time restoration of promo credits for a clear platform error is fine. Document decision and get customer sign-off.

alex.billing: Proposed remediation: reinstate 150 trial credits to acct_0a1b2c3d and flag their org so automated migrations skip promo rows for 30 days. Approve?

maria-billing: Approved. I'll do manual credit grant now and add a note in the billing system: "manual-reinstate: 150 trial credits due to merge sync bug".

maria-billing: Done — 150 credits granted at 2026-12-07T15:14:02Z. Customer should see balance immediately; email copy of grant sent to erin@alder.io.

jamie.cs: Forwarded confirmation to customer; they replied :relieved: and said thanks. I'll close the ticket once they confirm visibility.

ops-bot: Audit entry created: action=manual_credit_grant actor=maria-billing target=acct_0a1b2c3d amount=150 reason="merge sync overwrote active promo" timestamp=2026-12-07T15:14:02Z

jamie.cs: Closing loop — customer confirmed credits visible. Marking as resolved and filing an internal bug for the merge job. :white_check_mark:

maria-billing: Filed bug INF-4821: merge job precedence ordering can copy expired promo rows. Will prioritize patch for next deploy.

alex.billing: Nice catch everyone. We should add a short KB article explaining credit behavior on account merges to avoid repeat tickets.

jamie.cs: Agreed — will draft KB and link it in the support reply. Thanks!
